maddeler.e:
استبطنا (form X)
# اِسْتَبْطَنَا (istabṭanā) /is.tab.tˤa.naː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِسْتَبْطَنَ (istabṭana)
# اِسْتَبْطَنَّا (istabṭannā) /is.tab.tˤan.naː/: first-person plural past active of اِسْتَبْطَنَ (istabṭana)
# اِسْتَبْطِنَا (istabṭinā) /is.tab.tˤi.naː/: second-person dual imperative of اِسْتَبْطَنَ (istabṭana)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
